error TS2451: Cannot redeclare block-scoped variable 'foo'.


!!! error TS2451: Cannot redeclare block-scoped variable 'foo'.
==== destructuringReassignsRightHandSide.ts (0 errors) ====
    var foo: any = { foo: 1, bar: 2 };
    var bar: any;
    
    // reassignment in destructuring pattern
    ({ foo, bar } = foo);
    
    // reassignment in subsequent var
    var { foo, baz } = foo;
